findings.effect: rtt_supported_while_roaming_bool (CarrierConfigManager.java:10991-10992, default false at :12197) only narrows RTT while roaming, and every reader sits behind rtt_supported_bool: ImsRegistrationTracker.isRttSupported reads it only once RTT provisioning is on (ImsRegistrationTracker.java:585-598), which needs rtt_supported_bool (ImsManager.java:2756-2797); AosCondition.IsRttSupported returns false first when rtt_supported_bool is false (AosCondition.cpp:998-1011); TelecomAccountRegistry needs isRttEnabled, which is false while config_support_rtt is false (TelecomAccountRegistry.java:1136-1154, PhoneInterfaceManager.java:7995-8035, config.xml:235, same on lineage-24.0). The emergency registration does not read it (AosHandleEmergencyMtc.cpp:45-63). Emergency routing and TTY routing do not read it (EmergencyCallDomainSelector.java:755-756, 2045-2057). With RTT on, true lets the roaming registration carry TEXT and stops the native TTY-mode deregistration while roaming (AosCondition.cpp:1026-1031). On a phone: admitted only for the most specific profile that sets the key, else the Google-lane value, else Android's default false (Serving.kt:405-440).
findings.risk: None from holding: Android's default false stays, and rtt_supported_bool is held for these profiles too, so this key would do nothing.
